title: CLCON/2955/2005 of VIKRAM BAHAL and ORS. Vs STATE and ORS.

paras.text:
In the High Court of Uttaranchal, at Nainital.
Contempt Petition No. 2955 of 2005
Vikram Bahal S/o Late Nand Bahal,
R/o Nandan Kanan, Ekta Bihar,
Rahe Murtaja, Rampur, U.P. --- Petitioner.
Vs.
1- Sri Ajay Rautela S.P. City Dehradun.
2- Sri Vinod Kumar Jetha Station Officer, P.S
 Patel Nagar, Dehradun, Distt. Dehradun.
3- Sri Sarvesh Kumar, Sub Inspector, P.S.
 Patel Nagar, District Dehradun, I.O. of
 Crime No. 57 of 2005.
4- Sri Gyan Prakash Saxena S/o Jayanti Prasad
 Saxena, R/o H.I.G. 7, Phase-II, MDDA
 Colony, P.S. Patel Nagar,
 Dehradun ......Respondents.
Sri Arvind Vashist, learned counsel for the petitioners.
Sri I.P. Kohli, in brief, for Sri V.K. Kohli, Senior
Advocate, for the respondent Nos. 3 and 4.
Sri K.S. Rautela, learned A.G.A. for respondent Nos. 1 and 2.
Coram: Hon'ble Irshad Hussain, J.
 Hon'ble B.S. Verma, J.
Dated: 28-11-2005
(P.C):
 Heard Sri Arvind Vashist, learned counsel for the petitioner,
Sri I.P. Kohli, holding brief for Sri V.K. Koholi, leared Senior
Advocate, for the respondent Nos. 3 and 4 and Sri K.S. Rautela,
learned A.G.A. for respondent Nos. 1 and 2.
2- The applicant-petitioner has moved an application indicating
that the parties have entered in to a compromise and the
matrimonial dispute has ceased to exist. Smt. Shipra Bahel W/o
Vikram Bahel has decided to go with her husband to her
matrimonial home at Rampur where their children shall be brought
by respondent No.4 (Sri Gyan Prakash Saxena) within seven days.
Smt. Shipra Bahel has also undertaken to help in withdrawal/
quashing of the proceedings of criminal case No. 1099/2005
pending before the C.J.M. Dehradun and whereas the husband

Vikram Bahel has agreed to withdraw his petition pending in the
Family Court, Moradabad under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage
Act. Since the things have been settled amicably prayer was made
to dismiss the contempt petition as withdrawn. Considering the
above aspects of the matter, we also do not propose to continue
with the contempt petition against the alleged contemnors.
3- For the reasons aforesaid the contempt petition is dismissed
as withdrawn and the notices against the alleged contemnors are
discharged.
 (B.S. Verma, J.) (Irshad Hussain, J.)
ISB
